name: Curse of Bloodletting
description:
Attacks drain 0.5❤️ to deal +1❤️ damage.

  • [term:curse][red]Curse Spell[/red][/term]: [dark-red]Sacrifice 2.5❤️[/dark-red] to become aware for 30 seconds, during which you read other curses faster and without paying a sacrifice, and harvest slain enemies' souls, healing 1❤️.
